name: Interactive Brokers (IBKR)
description: Connect your Interactive Brokers account to Claude and manage your portfolio through natural language. Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data. You can also prompt Claude to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval. Claude never submits orders directly to the market. Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations. Member SIPC.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Interactive Brokers (IBKR) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Interactive Brokers (IBKR) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Interactive Brokers (IBKR) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) provides these MCP tools: get_account_balances, get_account_positions, get_account_summary, get_order_instructions, get_orders, get_portfolio_allocation, get_price_history, get_price_snapshot, get_trades, and search_contracts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Interactive Brokers (IBKR)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Interactive Brokers (IBKR) in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Interactive Brokers (IBKR) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Interactive Brokers (IBKR) is developed by Interactive Brokers. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
